rows.text: In the Rajya Sabha on 26 August 1997 Shri S.R. Bommai (Orissa), speaking 'as a Member, not as a Minister', said: 'As Janata Dal President, I have given a report in 1989 recommending reservation for women in Parliament and Assemblies.'
